_comment: Tolerances for tools/logcmp.py. 'default' applies to every common variable;
'vars' overrides it per variable. Keys: max_abs (absolute deviation limit),
mean_abs (limit on the mean absolute deviation), rel (limit as a fraction of
the largest absolute baseline value of that variable; the effective max_abs is
the larger of the two), interp ('linear' or 'hold').
These numbers are for the synthetic bench logs in this directory; real bench
tolerances belong next to the patch in patches/<name>/test/.
